# Somatic copy number aberrations {#pcgr-cna}

```{r cna_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

cna_pdf <- pcg_report$content$cna$callset$variant
cna_classes_pdf <- c("amplification", "homdel", "hemdel")
cna_key_pdf <- if ("VARIANT_CLASS" %in% colnames(cna_pdf)) {
  cna_pdf |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$VARIANT_CLASS %in% cna_classes_pdf)
} else cna_pdf[0, , drop = FALSE]
## potentially oncogenic events (as for AMP/ASCO/CAP Tier 3): amplified
## proto-oncogenes and deep deletions of tumor suppressor genes - not, e.g.,
## amplified tumor suppressors
is_onc_amp <- cna_key_pdf$VARIANT_CLASS == "amplification" &
  if ("ONCOGENE" %in% colnames(cna_key_pdf)) cna_key_pdf$ONCOGENE %in% TRUE else FALSE
is_tsg_del <- cna_key_pdf$VARIANT_CLASS %in% c("homdel", "hemdel") &
  if ("TUMOR_SUPPRESSOR" %in% colnames(cna_key_pdf))
    cna_key_pdf$TUMOR_SUPPRESSOR %in% TRUE else FALSE
## OncoKB-curated oncogenic / likely oncogenic events (when OncoKB is
## enabled), as in the HTML report
is_okb_onc <- if ("ONCOGENICITY_OKB" %in% colnames(cna_key_pdf))
  cna_key_pdf$ONCOGENICITY_OKB %in% c("Oncogenic", "Likely Oncogenic") else FALSE
cna_key_pdf <- cna_key_pdf[is_onc_amp | is_tsg_del | is_okb_onc, , drop = FALSE]
## ranked by actionability tier (1-3), then amplifications by copy number
## (highest first) before deep deletions, then gene symbol
if (NROW(cna_key_pdf) > 0) {
  tier_rank <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(cna_key_pdf$ACTIONABILITY_TIER))
  cn <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cna_key_pdf$CN_TOTAL))
  cna_key_pdf <- cna_key_pdf[order(
    dplyr::coalesce(tier_rank, 99L),
    cna_key_pdf$VARIANT_CLASS != "amplification",
    -dplyr::coalesce(cn, 0),
    cna_key_pdf$SYMBOL), , drop = FALSE]
}
n_cna_key_pdf <- NROW(cna_key_pdf)
```

Listed below are potentially oncogenic copy number events: amplifications of known proto-oncogenes, deep deletions of tumor suppressor genes, and - when OncoKB annotation is enabled - events classified as oncogenic or likely oncogenic by OncoKB [@Chakravarty2017-rd]. Events are ranked by clinical actionability tier (therapeutic), then by copy number.

## Amplified proto-oncogenes and deleted tumor suppressors

```{r cna_key_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr n_cna_key_pdf > 0

cna_key_pdf |>
  utils::head(max_variants_pdf) |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
    "SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL_GENE_ID", "VARIANT_CLASS", "CN_TOTAL", "CYTOBAND",
    "ACTIONABILITY_TIER", "ONCOGENICITY_OKB"))) |>
  pcgrr:::pdf_table_variants(color = report_color, oncokb = TRUE)
```

```{r cna_key_none_msg}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_cna_key_pdf == 0
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(kind = "empty", paste0(
  "No amplifications of proto-oncogenes or deep deletions of tumor ",
  "suppressor genes were found in this tumor sample.")))
```

## Copy number profile

```{r cna_profile_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

cna_conf_pdf <- pcg_report$settings$conf$somatic_cna
sp_pdf <- pcg_report$settings$conf$sample_properties
cna_plot_pdf <- pcgrr:::pdf_cna_plot_settings(pcg_report)
cna_segments_pdf <- pcg_report$content$cna$callset$segment
has_profile_pdf <- NROW(cna_segments_pdf) > 0 &&
  NROW(pcg_report$settings$chrom_coordinates) > 0
genome_doubled_pdf <- isTRUE(as.logical(cna_conf_pdf$genome_doubled))
na_or <- function(x, f = identity) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || x %in% "NA") "N/A" else f(x)
}

ploidy_source_pdf <- na_or(sp_pdf$tumor_ploidy_source)
cna_absolute_caption_pdf <- paste0(
  "Absolute copy number profile: total copy number per segment. Dotted ",
  "lines (see legend) indicate the tumor ploidy (",
  cna_plot_pdf$tumor_ploidy, ") and the effective thresholds for ",
  "gain, deletion and amplification (threshold mode: ",
  cna_plot_pdf$threshold_mode, "). Segments too short to render as a bar ",
  "at whole-genome scale are drawn as a point at their midpoint; triangles ",
  "mark amplifications/gains of proto-oncogenes (up) and deep deletions of ",
  "tumor suppressor genes (down).")
cna_relative_caption_pdf <- paste0(
  "Relative copy number profile: copy number per segment relative to the ",
  "tumor ploidy, with the corresponding thresholds as dotted lines.")
```

```{r cna_profile_kpis}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: true

cat(pcgrr:::pdf_kpi_row(list(
  list(title = "Tumor ploidy",
       value = as.character(cna_plot_pdf$tumor_ploidy),
       sub = if (ploidy_source_pdf == "N/A")
         "Not available - diploid assumed" else
           paste0("Source: ", ploidy_source_pdf)),
  list(title = "Fraction of genome altered",
       value = na_or(cna_conf_pdf$fraction_genome_altered,
                     function(x) paste0(round(100 * as.numeric(x), 1), "%"))),
  list(title = "Whole-genome doubling",
       value = if (is.null(cna_conf_pdf$genome_doubled)) "N/A" else
         if (genome_doubled_pdf) "Yes" else "No",
       sub = na_or(cna_conf_pdf$wgd_fraction, function(x) paste0(
         round(100 * as.numeric(x)), "% of genome with major CN >= 2")),
       color = if (genome_doubled_pdf) pcgrr::color_palette$warning else NULL))))
```

```{r cna_profile_absolute}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr has_profile_pdf
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.4
#| fig-cap: !expr cna_absolute_caption_pdf

pcgrr::plot_cna_segments_absolute(
  chrom_coordinates = pcg_report$settings$chrom_coordinates,
  cna_segment = cna_segments_pdf,
  cna_gene = pcg_report$content$cna$callset$variant,
  tumor_ploidy = cna_plot_pdf$tumor_ploidy,
  amp_threshold_effective = cna_plot_pdf$amp_threshold_effective,
  threshold_mode = cna_plot_pdf$threshold_mode,
  gain_threshold_effective = cna_plot_pdf$gain_threshold_effective,
  del_threshold_effective = cna_plot_pdf$del_threshold_effective) |>
  pcgrr:::pdf_plot_theme(base_size = 7) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(family = "sans", size = 7),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "sans", size = 6)) +
  ggplot2::guides(colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2),
                  fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

```{r cna_profile_relative}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr has_profile_pdf
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-cap: !expr cna_relative_caption_pdf

pcgrr::plot_cna_segments_relative(
  chrom_coordinates = pcg_report$settings$chrom_coordinates,
  cna_segment = cna_segments_pdf,
  cna_gene = pcg_report$content$cna$callset$variant,
  tumor_ploidy = cna_plot_pdf$tumor_ploidy,
  amp_threshold_effective = cna_plot_pdf$amp_threshold_effective,
  threshold_mode = cna_plot_pdf$threshold_mode,
  gain_threshold_effective = cna_plot_pdf$gain_threshold_effective,
  del_threshold_effective = cna_plot_pdf$del_threshold_effective) |>
  pcgrr:::pdf_plot_theme(base_size = 7) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(family = "sans", size = 7),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "sans", size = 6)) +
  ggplot2::guides(colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2),
                  fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```
